description_sq:
Shesim Apartament 3+1 ne Qender te Tiranes. 
Apartamenti ndodhet ne katin e 6 dhe te fundit te nje ndertimi 6 katesh i viteve 2000 pa ashensor (mundesia e vendosjes se nje ashensori te personalizuar), disponon nje siperfaqe totale198.8 m2, nga te cilat 176 m2 jane pjese e siperfaqes se brendeshme, 22.8 m2 jane pjese e siperfaqes se perbashket, si dhe tarracen komplet ne shfrytezim me nje siperfaqe prej 86 m2.
Organizohet ne forme dupleksi dhe ka 1 sallon ndenje me kendin e gatimit dhe te ngrenies totalisht te vecuar, 3 dhoma gjumi dhe 2 tualete. 
Lokacion perfekt pasi ndodhet ne nje distance prej vetem 50 metra nga Sheshi Skenderbej. 
Disponon dokumentacion te rregullt hipotekor. 
Per nje vizite ne prone jeni te mirepritur te na kontaktoni!
title_en: Apartment 3+1+2 in the Center of Tirana!
description_en: We are selling a 3+1 apartment in the center of Tirana. The apartment is located on the 6th and last floor of a 6-story building from the 2000s without an elevator (possibility of installing a personalized elevator), has a total area of 198.8 m2, of which 176 m2 are part of the internal surface, 22.8 m2 are part of the common surface, as well as the entire terrace in use with a surface of 86 m2. It is organized in the form of a duplex and has 1 living room with a completely separate cooking and dining area, 3 bedrooms and 2 bathrooms. Perfect location as it is located at a distance of only 50 meters from Skenderbej Square. Has regular mortgage documentation. For a visit to the property, you are welcome to contact us!
